entries.653637aecbb48598: This department handles car accessories, sports goods, toys, bicycles, leisure goods, pet supplies and other goods. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, pet supplies, mainly dog and cat food, were weak, while electric bicycles, mainly DCM-brand, performed well.
entries.667c228d2dff6e9a: This department handles gardening supplies, large machinery, agricultural and business materials, outdoor materials, plants and other goods. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, vegetable seedlings and seeds performed well, and from January onward, snow removal goods also performed well due to snowfall.

entries.709411666c7566cd: This is the business in which DCM Co., Ltd. mainly operates home center stores nationwide. Encho Co., Ltd., which became a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange in September 2025, and Hometech Co., Ltd., whose entire shares were acquired in December 2025, are also included in this business. It is the reportable segment with the largest revenue from external customers. As of February 28, 2026, the group had 918 stores. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, the group opened nine stores and closed seven, and 53 stores of Encho and 20 stores of Hometech were added. It also develops DCM-brand products and is raising their share of revenue.
entries.7edd84ad8be8674f: This division handles household appliances, heating and cooling, electrical materials and lighting, AV and information equipment, housing equipment, exteriors and others. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, cassette stoves, gas cylinders and batteries were affected by the reaction to the previous year's disaster-prevention demand, while air conditioners and LED bulbs performed well owing to the expanded introduction in stores of MAXZEN (PB products of Xprice Co., Ltd.).

entries.d8b8a7f32507e100: This is the EC business, carried out mainly by Xprice Co., Ltd. Xprice Co., Ltd. and Maxzen Co., Ltd. are in charge, and they focus on selling the PB product "MAXZEN". MAXZEN is also being introduced more widely in home center stores. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 increased from the previous year.

Revenue from external customers is printed as ¥255 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026, which does not account for the majority of consolidated revenue.
entries.dc3d451dde765b1e: This department handles work supplies, hardware, tools, paints, repair supplies, lumber, building materials and other goods. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, demand for disaster-prevention and crime-prevention goods fell back from the high level of the previous year, while air-conditioned work wear performed well during the intense heat. In terms of sales by department, this is the largest department within the Home Center Business.
